name: CTI Electric
old_description: At CTI Electric, we’re dedicated to providing exceptional electrical solutions for commercial, industrial, and manufacturing clients. With our commitment to superior customer service, expertise, and professionalism, we empower businesses with the highest standards of safety, quality, and reliability.
about:
CTI Electric operates from Clearfield, Utah, where it has provided electrical contracting services for more than 20 years. The company's founding year and original owners are not publicly disclosed, but it has built a presence across six counties in the Greater Salt Lake area.

The firm delivers a range of electrical construction and service work, including lightning protection, medium-voltage systems, design-build projects, and general electrical installation. It also provides security systems such as intrusion detection, access control, CCTV, and fire alarm, along with low-voltage structured cabling for telecommunications and cathodic protection. Preventive maintenance, coordination studies, switchgear, emergency power, troubleshooting, and industrial automation controls round out the service portfolio. The work is performed by certified designers and specialty-certified tradespeople, though headcount and facility size are not published.

Clients span commercial, industrial, and manufacturing sectors, as well as construction and telecommunications firms. Reference customers cited by the company include R&O Construction, Northern Construction, Boeing, and City Light & Power.

CTI Electric emphasizes honesty, transparency, and a culture of care for employees and partners as its differentiating values. It also highlights its Lightning Protection Institute certification and the use of specialty-certified tradespeople as factors that set it apart.
